value.message: Town of Oakville runs Learn to Swim - Preschool (Levels A-E) - their site says you can browse options online starting Aug 4, with fall registration opening Tuesday, Aug 11 at 7am. YMCA of Oakville also lists Preschool Swim Lessons for 3 to 5 year olds, but I could not get into their page today for times or price. I'll keep watching and text you when more posts.
